exact_morphism_proof: Both full scans print l’isomorphisme(*) de la preuve de(1.8). The inspected231–232 text has no starred formula in either proof. The displayed isomorphism is exactly the Lemma1.7 map at S=Y, f_1=f:X→Y and f_2=Id_Y, using X×_Y Y≅X. The proof has already reduced f to a closed immersion. At y=f(x), put R=O_{Y,y}, B=O_{X,x}; for a flat resolution P of F_y the chain maps e⊗p↦e⊗(1⊗p) and e⊗(b⊗p)↦be⊗p are inverse between E_x⊗_R P and E_x⊗_B(B⊗_R P). They realize the stalk of the canonical adjunction projection map. Off X both stalks are zero, since f is closed. This proves the displayed map in the actual proof scope, including complexes not assumed quasi-coherent. Current cites l’isomorphisme de(1.7), removing the nonexistent star and proof locator; diplomatic retains the complete printed phrase. This is an explicit editorial repair, with no claim about an unseen author draft.
